hotels.title: Costa del Sol Beachfront Luxury with Daily Breakfast, EUR80 Dining Credit & Exclusive Beach Club
hotels.description: Experience Mediterranean glamour along Spain’s Costa del Sol at this modern beachfront resort, where swaying palm trees, golden sands and crystal-clear waters create the perfect coastal escape. The onsite Azure Beach Club is a must-visit, offering a pool, beach and lounge area - an ideal spot to relax, people-watch and enjoy spectacular sunsets. Indulge in hearty Italian cuisine paired with an extensive wine list at Isola or embrace the beachfront ambience with a refreshing cocktail and Spanish tapas at El Bar De Lola, nestled under lush vines by the resort’s shimmering pool. Venture beyond the resort to explore Estepona’s charming Old Town, stroll around the stylish Puerto Banús marina or dive into Marbella’s vibrant art scene at the Museo del Grabado. After a day of exploring, unwind at the MOI Spa with a soothing massage or luxurious facial, or swim a few laps in the indoor pool after a workout at the world-class fitness centre.
